skill.name: lark-wiki
skill.description: 飞书知识库：管理知识空间、空间成员和文档节点。创建和查询知识空间、查看和管理空间成员、管理节点层级结构、在知识库中组织文档和快捷方式。当用户需要在知识库中查找或创建文档、浏览知识空间结构、查看或管理空间成员、移动或复制节点时使用。当用户给出 doubao.com 的 /wiki/ URL/token 时，也应直接使用本 skill，不要因为域名不是飞书而回退到 WebFetch；路由依据是 URL 路径模式和 token，而不是域名。不负责：上传文件到知识库节点下（走 lark-drive）、编辑文档/表格/Base 内容（走 lark-doc / lark-sheets / lark-base）。
skill.summary: Manage Lark Wiki spaces, nodes, memberships, and document organization through authenticated lark-cli workflows.
skill.author: larksuite

security_audit.summary: All 156 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown links, inline code, CLI examples, URL placeholders, and high-entropy Chinese prose. The reviewed files contain no executable scripts, path traversal, system reconnaissance, obfuscated payloads, or unauthorized network behavior. The skill documents authenticated Lark Wiki operations and requires explicit confirmation for irreversible deletion and other high-risk writes.

content.user_title: Manage Lark Wiki Spaces and Content
content.value_statement: Managing Lark Wiki structures and access through raw API calls is slow and error-prone. This skill guides authenticated listing, creation, movement, copying, deletion, and member administration.
actual_capabilities: Lists accessible Wiki spaces with pagination controls.
Creates Wiki spaces and nodes using user identity.
Lists and inspects nodes from tokens, object identifiers, or Wiki links.
Moves or copies nodes across spaces and parent nodes.
Deletes nodes or spaces with confirmation and asynchronous task tracking.
Lists, adds, and removes users, groups, departments, or applications as space members.
limitations: Requires lark-cli, valid authentication, and the necessary Lark API scopes.
Does not edit document, spreadsheet, slide, or Base content.
Does not upload or download files stored under Wiki nodes.
List operations may require explicit pagination to retrieve every result.

use_cases.title: Audit Wiki access
use_cases.description: List a space and its members before reviewing roles or planning access changes.

use_cases.title: Organize knowledge structures
use_cases.description: Inspect node hierarchies, then create, move, or copy content into a clear structure.

use_cases.title: Prepare project workspaces
use_cases.description: Create a project space, add starter nodes, and grant the correct team access.

prompt_templates.title: List my Wiki spaces
prompt_templates.prompt: List the Lark Wiki spaces available to my user account. Show each name, space identifier, type, and visibility.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect a Wiki hierarchy
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the Wiki space named [space name]. Resolve its identifier, list all pages with bounded pagination, and summarize the hierarchy.

prompt_templates.title: Create a project section
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Wiki node titled [title] under [parent link]. Confirm the resolved parent and target space before writing.

prompt_templates.title: Plan and execute a reorganization
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [source space] and propose moves into [target structure]. Use dry runs, request confirmation for each write group, then verify final locations.

output_examples.input: List my Wiki spaces and show only the information needed to choose one.
output: Personal Library | person | private | resolved from my_library

output_examples.input: Show the pages under the Engineering Wiki onboarding section.
Prepare to remove the archived knowledge space named Customer Ledger.
output_examples.output: One candidate was found. Customer Ledger, team space, ID 7629741305993170448. Explicit confirmation is required before permanent deletion.

best_practices: Use user identity unless the request explicitly requires the application view.
Resolve names and links to verified identifiers before any write operation.
Use dry runs and explicit confirmation for moves, copies, membership changes, and deletions.
anti_patterns: Do not pass a Wiki URL, title, or node token as a space identifier.
Do not guess member types, roles, or identifiers from incomplete user input.
Do not repeat invalid or denied requests without correcting parameters or permissions.

faq.question: What authentication does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses lark-cli authentication. Most personal Wiki operations should run with user identity and the required Lark API scopes.

faq.question: Can it edit the contents of a document?
faq.answer: No. It manages Wiki spaces and nodes. Document editing belongs to the dedicated Lark document, spreadsheet, or Base skills.

faq.question: Can it manage Wiki members?
faq.answer: Yes. It can list, add, and remove users, groups, departments, or applications when identifiers, roles, and permissions are available.

faq.question: Does it support personal document libraries?
faq.answer: Yes. It resolves my_library through user identity before using the resulting space identifier.

faq.question: How are destructive operations protected?
faq.answer: Space and node deletion require explicit confirmation. The workflows also support dry runs and verification of resolved targets.

faq.question: Does listing always return every item?
faq.answer: No. List commands return one page by default. Enable bounded pagination or continue from the returned page token when needed.
